description: This Java source file defines the `DoorLockDeviceShell` class, which provides command-line shell interface methods for managing mock door lock devices in a Zigbee simulation environment. It includes commands for listing, adding, locking, unlocking, toggling, and configuring low battery and PIN settings for door locks.

classes.name: DoorLockDeviceShell
classes.description: Provides shell commands to manage mock door lock devices in a Zigbee emulation environment.

classes.name: DoorLockDeviceShell.NameValueProvider
classes.description: Provides device name suggestions for door lock commands.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all door lock devices with their details in a tabular format.

methods.name: addDoorLock
methods.description: Adds a new mock door lock device with a specified or autogenerated name.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the specified door lock device.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the specified door lock device.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the lock state of the specified door lock device.

methods.name: lowBattery
methods.description: Sets the specified door lock device as having low battery.

methods.name: lowBatteryRestore
methods.description: Resets the low battery status of the specified door lock device.

methods.name: lowBatteryToggle
methods.description: Toggles the low battery status of the specified door lock device.

methods.name: addPin
methods.description: Adds a PIN code to the door lock device.

methods.name: getPins
methods.description: Retrieves and displays all PIN codes associated with the door lock device.
